scope: scripts/qualify_vendor_workload.py on Debug builds of fcf65a33 (artifacts/vw3, git archive) with one owned TIA Portal V21 Update 3 on PCNico. The seven retained PAL/DMC downloads (467,587,713 bytes; each checked against docs/verification/vendor-intake-review-20261025.json) were staged and classified through the Host in 6.0 s in total: 55 PAL XML sources, 22 DMC global-library archives and one example project archive. Every DMC archive (V14 SP1 to V19) went through library_upgrade in one owned Portal: 18 upgraded into V21 (6,346 types, 6,364 versions, 31-76 s each, 871 s together), each listed completely and closed; the Portal's working set grew from 1,251 MiB to 4,590 MiB. The other four (V17, V18 and V19 Professional, V14 SP1 (S7-300)) were refused at prepare with LibraryPathTooLong, nothing copied, because their upgraded directory would be 144 characters under this 52-character artifact root. Source archives were unchanged after every upgrade.
limitations: Observations on this host, not budgets; one Portal for all upgrades, so memory accumulates across them.
Upgrade and listing only; the upgraded types are not instantiated or compiled here (DMC compilation has its own record), and PAL's V16 SimaticML still needs an intermediate TIA version.
Four archive names need an artifact root at least one character shorter than 52 characters.
